text:
Rae (People Ops): Heads-up: courier left an oversized box labeled 'photo prop - mannequin' and an umbrella at 10:20 for Juno's 11:00 session. Lobby's tight and badge printer just went into "offline" mode. Can we triage?

Hector (Front Desk): Logged MAN-502 (mannequin) and UMB-21 (umbrella). Printer showing 'connection error'  trying restart now. Also mannequin is big  blocking the right side bench.

Samir (Facilities): I can move MAN-502 to Storage Rack 5 if someone spots the assembly screws inside. It might need two people to carry.

Juno: That's for me  it's the torso we use for quick outfit shots. I can be down at 10:40 to help move it. Also can we hold the umbrella in case my guest needs it later?

DeliveryBot: MAN-502 scanned at 10:18. Photo attached: man_1850001105.jpg. Delivery note: "left at reception". UMB-21 scanned at 10:19.

Hector (Front Desk): Printer rebooted but BadgeBot says license expired? Trying manual print on sticky notes meanwhile. Hector to BadgeBot: @BadgeBot can you confirm license status?

BadgeBot: Alert: Badge printer license expiring in 2 days. Manual printing available. Recommend contacting ops for renewal.

Rae (People Ops): I'll queue a request with vendor ops after the meeting. For now Hector, please issue a temporary handwritten badge with "Guest - Juno's attendee" and log ID when they check in.

Hector (Front Desk): Temporary badge ready. Also FYI umbrella has a wet drip  placed on towel to avoid puddles.

Samir (Facilities): Moving mannequin to Rack 5 with one lift. Juno, Rack 5 is on the mezzanine near studio C. Need help to secure the torso plate.

Juno: I'll meet you at 10:40. Also quick note: my guest has mobility needs and asked for the swivel chair near the demo wall. Can we reserve it?

Rae (People Ops): Reserving swivel chair for Juno's guest and labeling "Reserved - Guest". Also adding note for accessibility (low height table).

Hector (Front Desk): Guest checked in at 10:56. ID scanned and logged in ledger. Temporary badge issued: "Guest - Juno's attendee". Umbrella given to guest as requested.

Samir (Facilities): Mannequin secured on Rack 5, screws found in small envelope and taped to the back of the torso. Hand truck returned.

Juno: Thanks team  saved me a ton of time. Rae if you can follow up on BadgeBot license that would be great.

Rae (People Ops): Will do. Quick follow-up poll: should we add a small "wet items" shelf at the lobby for umbrellas and plants to avoid towels? Reply with :+1: for yes.

Hector (Front Desk): :+1: would help.

Samir (Facilities): :+1: safer for floors.

BadgeBot: License renewal scheduled in 48 hours pending approval by finance.
